name: Reflex Advanced Materials Corp.
summary: Engaged in the exploration of mineral properties across Canada, Freedom Battery Metals Inc. possesses an exclusive option to secure full ownership (a 100% interest) in the Zigzag lithium property. This significant asset encompasses eight claims, totaling approximately 2,710 hectares, located in the Crescent Lake Area of Ontario's Thunder Bay Mining Division. The company, which was established in 2021 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada, previously operated as Reflex Exploration Inc. before adopting the name Freedom Battery Metals Inc. in April 2022.
